title: Green Flash Mystery Explained

scenes.text: Why does the sun vanish in a flash over Hawaii?
scenes.query2: sun setting over sea with vibrant colors

scenes.text: The green flash lasts only 1‑2 seconds at sunset.
scenes.query: close-up of sun edge green flash

scenes.text: It appears when clear horizons let atmospheric refraction separate colors.
scenes.query2: diagram showing light bending in atmosphere

scenes.text: Scientists say it's a refraction trick, not a hidden signal.

description: The fleeting green flash dazzles watchers worldwide, but science has a clear answer. Stay tuned for more unexplained sky phenomena.
